description: A grouped status post, as built by the pinned connector CLI (connector/cli.py _post_status) and validated by ingest.post_status. A group the state does not call for is absent, never empty-filled. refs are references only — no todo state is accepted or stored. owner_waiting is a sticky declaration: it survives later posts until an explicit null or a terminal status clears it. A terminal post resolves the poster's pending waits (contract 05).

handle.description: The posting lane's registered handle (on-behalf). An unregistered handle is refused.

owner_waiting.description: Sticky owner-waiting declaration; explicit null clears it.

tail.description: Tail items (kinds DEFECT | FOLLOWUP | QUESTION) with their provenance.

title: Status post (contract 03)
